instructions: NONEXECUTABLE TEMPLATE: replace every <PLACEHOLDER> with captured source facts and computed digests. Remove any unproven optional subject, property or edge. Never ingest this template as evidence. Duplicate product/variant/package/label refs for a second product. Every new subject also requires subjectEvidence in buildQualiaIntent.
notes: Source refs, locator refs, subject refs and proposal IDs share one namespace. Use source-label for the source, label for the subject, panel-quote for its locator, and p-label for a proposal; never reuse a ref across categories.
Organization.entityKind LEGAL_ENTITY and legalName need evidence of actual legal identity; UNSPECIFIED avoids silently treating a brand or trading name as a registered corporation.

Replace publicActorBasis with the proved enum: OFFICER_OR_DIRECTOR, FOUNDER_OR_INVESTOR, AUTHOR_OR_INVESTIGATOR, SPEAKER_OR_CREATOR, CLINICIAN_PUBLIC_COMMENTATOR, ENDORSER_NAMED_BY_REGULATOR or OTHER_PUBLIC_ROLE. Do not ingest personal contacts, addresses or family data.

Choose the evidenced materialKind; CHEMICALLY_DEFINED is only a template example. Botanical ingredients can use BOTANICAL_PREPARATION. Label spelling alone does not establish salt, moiety or chemical equivalence: omit REALIZES_SUBSTANCE when unresolved.

Unknown amount is omitted and amountBasis NOT_STATED. When captured, add numeric amount plus unitCode (for example mg) and actual amountBasis (PER_SERVING, PER_UNIT, PER_DAY, etc.). Never default a dose.
Only add OWNS_BRAND when ownership is stated; a product page alone can establish branding without corporate ownership.
Use actual roleKind (FOUNDER, DIRECTOR, ADVISOR, EXECUTIVE_OFFICER, etc.) when proved; do not default every public person to advisor.
LabelVersion is immutable product content state; SourceSnapshot is the immutable source capture generated from sources[].snapshot. Neither is a generic StateSnapshot node.
contentDigest hashes the normalized full panel; compositionDigest hashes normalized composition lines. They are different from the raw captured-source contentHash.
